item.title: A Heavenly Point of View Changes Everything
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he dives into the biblical account of 2 Kings 6:8, revealing the transformative power of having a heavenly point of view in a chaotic world. In this practical and inspiring sermon, Pastor Chris will show you how to shift your focus from earthly worries to God's divine plan, giving you hope, peace, and a fresh perspective on life. Don't miss this powerful message that will change your life forever.

item.title: Standing Firm in the Face of Spiritual Attack
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful testimony of spiritual warfare and the victory of God's life-giving power. Hear the incredible story of how Pastor Chris's life was literally threatened by a severe spiritual attack, but he refused to back down and instead chose to stand on the truth of God's Word. This sermon will inspire and equip you to stand strong in the face of adversity and experience the miraculous breakthroughs that come from living by faith.

item.title: When Faith Outruns Fear
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delivers a powerful message of faith and perseverance in the face of spiritual attack. In this sermon, Pastor Chris shares a personal testimony of being under attack with a life-threatening condition, but refusing to back down, and instead standing on God's promises to bring healing and deliverance. Hear how Pastor Chris's bold faith in the midst of adversity sparked a miracle that will leave you encouraged and challenged to trust God in your own battles.

item.title: Standing Firm in Spiritual Warfare
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a personal testimony of spiritual warfare and the importance of standing firm in faith, even in the midst of intense physical and emotional attacks. Listen as Pastor Zehner recounts his own experience of being taken to the brink of collapse, but rising up in worship and faith to see God's miraculous intervention. This is a must-listen for anyone who has ever faced spiritual battles and needs to be encouraged to stand strong in their faith.

Don't miss this unforgettable story of God's intervention and redemption.
